text: 国家统计局最新公布的70个大中城市商品住宅销售价格数据显示，7月份广州一手住宅销售价格环比指数100.1，二手住宅销售价格环比指数100.4，一二手住宅房价环比指数已经连续5个月上涨，市场回稳向好态势不断巩固。房价回升的情况下，市场成交持续活跃。随着提升公积金贷款额度、发放“卖旧买新”专项补贴、国企收购二手住房等政策效应持续释放，近期市场活跃度保持高位。7月以来全市一手商品房网签面积同比保持正增长。7月1日-31日全市一手商品房网签面积较去年同期增长5.8%，其中一手住宅网签面积较去年同期增长9%。8月上半月（8月1日-15日）一手商品房网签面积较去年同
text_en: Data from the National Bureau of Statistics on commercial housing prices in 70 major cities shows that in July, Guangzhou's new home prices rose 0.1% month-on-month and resale home prices rose 0.4%, marking five consecutive months of gains and solidifying market stabilization. With prices recovering, transaction activity remains brisk. Policy effects such as higher provident fund loan limits, subsidies for selling old homes to buy new ones, and state-owned enterprise purchases of resale homes have kept activity elevated. Since July, online new home sales area in the city has maintained positive year-on-year growth. From July 1-31, online new home sales area rose 5.8% year-on-year, with new residential sales up 9%.
